project.description: The name of the project to initialize GitLab CI for.

projects.description: The list of projects to initialize GitLab CI for.

components.x-prompt: Should gitlab ci/cd components be used
components.description: Whether to use GitLab CI/CD components.

componentsSource.description: The source for the GitLab CI/CD components.

nest.description: Whether the workspace contains NestJS projects.
